core_obligations: Subgroup: the support of a section is closed (support section closed lemma), so the proper-over-base section material applies; the union closedness lemma shows the subset of f_*F(V) of sections with proper support is a subgroup (proof lines 394-400).
Sub presheaf: the base change closedness lemma shows the rule defines a sub presheaf of f_*F (proof lines 401-403).

Sheaf condition: given s in f_*F(V) and an etale covering {V_i -> V} with s|_{V_i} of support proper over V_i, the support of s|_{V_i} is the inverse image of the support of s (stalk characterization and the stalk pullback lemma); hence the support of s is proper over V by the descending property lemma (proof lines 404-413).
proof_roadmap: Sub presheaf via base change closedness (proof lines 401-403).
Sheaf condition via support pullback and descent (proof lines 404-413).
